## Work completed

Root coordinated three actual independent review agents: source/access review, protocol-boundary review and training review. They read the same project contract; the protocol reviewer and training reviewer examined separate risks. No unavailable branded models or external services are claimed to have run. Their findings informed the implementation; the source catalog remains untrusted research context.

Inspected three accessible public pages directly: one Reddit x402 announcement and two Substack agent-payment articles. The discovery catalog records original URLs, curated short research notes, unknown publication times where necessary and two genuine access failures: YouTube and X. No video was watched, no transcript obtained, no paywall/login bypass attempted and no whole social corpus scraped. Hashes bind our curated catalog, not unseen page bytes. No social content or summaries were used to fine-tune a model.

The source pages suggest two useful product questions: can MEW expose understandable spend/retry controls for agent commerce, and can a pilot demonstrate separately authenticated payment and delivery? These are our hypotheses, not measured customer demand. Verify technical mechanisms using official code and specifications. Do not repeat social claims about volume, fees or adoption as facts.

`src/learning/proposal.mjs` validates fixed authority, strict fields, bounded text/arrays, known evidence IDs and trusted expected hashes supplied separately. It has no core/server/payment imports. Review records bind role, identity, verdict and proposal digest. Local digests detect changes; they do not authenticate the reviewers. Rule suggestions are inert strings, never executable conditions or patches. Changed proposals or reused reviewer identities fail validation. Missing or abstaining reviews block progression. There is no automatic activation endpoint.

Existing deterministic MEW accounting remains the protocol core: principal mandates, exact integer lovelace, atomic reservation, immutable effect identity, no second dispatch on replay, retained UNKNOWN exposure and separate settlement/delivery facts. Model training cannot establish these properties; implementation and tests do. No social consensus may rewrite a persisted mandate or release uncertain funds.
